content.summary: Stocks that outperform the market usually share key traits such as rising sales, expanding margins, and increasing returns on capital. The select few that can do all three for many years are often the ones that make you life-changing money.

content.title: Chart (GTLS): 3 Reasons We Love This Stock
content.summary: Since September 2020, the S&P 500 has delivered a total return of 105%. But one standout stock has doubled the market - over the past five years, Chart has surged 206% to $199.80 per share. Its momentum hasn’t stopped as it’s also gained 22.6% in the last six months thanks to its solid quarterly results, beating the S&P by 7.1%.

content.title: 1 Value Stock on Our Buy List and 2 That Underwhelm
content.summary: Value investing has created more billionaires than any other strategy, like Warren Buffett, who built his fortune by purchasing wonderful businesses at reasonable prices. But these hidden gems are few and far between - many stocks that appear cheap often stay that way because they face structural issues.
